summary: Frontend-only testing of Prescriptor Comercial role and Commercial Work View features. All 7 requested features verified and working correctly via Playwright UI testing.
seed_data_creation: Test contact 'TEST_Contacto_Prescriptor' created and cleaned up after testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Prescriptor and Commercial role features fully working. Prescriptor user 'Juan García - Prescriptor' (PRESCRIPTOR1) has restricted access to PrescriptorAgenda only. Commercial user COMSA has TIENDA SALAMANCA shop assigned with project EXP-2026-00099.

prescriptor_restricted_view.details: Prescriptor user (isPrescriptor=true) sees ONLY PrescriptorAgenda.jsx with amber/orange color scheme. NO sidebar visible (CRM, Presupuesto, etc. are hidden).

prescriptor_add_contact.details: Prescriptor can add new contacts with name, phone, email, company, segment. Modal opens with 'NUEVO CONTACTO POTENCIAL' header. Contact saved successfully.

prescriptor_contacts_in_admin_crm.details: Contacts created by prescriptor appear in Admin CRM with 'PRESCRIPTOR' column showing 'Juan García - Prescriptor'. Filter dropdown 'Todos los prescriptores' available.

prescriptor_logout.details: Prescriptor logout button (data-testid='prescriptor-logout-btn') works correctly, returns to login page.

commercial_mis_tiendas_button.details: Commercial user (isRepresentative=true, isAdmin=false) sees 'MIS TIENDAS' button (data-testid='commercial-panel-nav-btn') in sidebar with purple color.

commercial_mis_tiendas_view.details: Mis Tiendas modal shows: summary cards (Tiendas Asignadas, Proyectos, Oportunidades), assigned shops list (TIENDA SALAMANCA), projects section (EXP-2026-00099), opportunities section.

admin_full_application.details: Admin user sees full application with all sidebar buttons: CRM, Presupuesto, IA Lab, Archivo, Digitalizador, Panel Admin, Master, Salir.

mis_tiendas_modal.header: MIS TIENDAS - Trabajo de tiendas asignadas a COMERCIAL SALAMANCA

admin_crm_contacts.prescriptor_attribution: Shows 'Juan García - Prescriptor' in PRESCRIPTOR column for contacts created by prescriptor

code_review.App.js_lines_225-235: Prescriptor conditional rendering correctly implemented - returns PrescriptorAgenda component without sidebar when currentUser.isPrescriptor is true
code_review.App.js_lines_355-364: Commercial 'Mis Tiendas' button correctly shown only for non-admin representatives (!isAdmin && isRepresentative)
code_review.PrescriptorAgenda.jsx: Well-structured component with proper API integration, form validation, and amber color scheme
code_review.CommercialWorkView.jsx: Modal component with summary cards, shop list, projects, and opportunities sections
